title: Book section lecture clips
description: Derived map from a book TOC id to YouTube clips. Do not store Zoom, Box, or other archive files. Student playback is YouTube-only.

description.description: Human note about this file. Placeholder maps should say PLACEHOLDER.

titles.description: Optional UI label for a bookSectionId. Example: sec-1-3-1 → Headings, div, and span.

sections.description: bookSectionId → clips, or an object with clips plus optional full-lecture fields. Keys are book TOC anchors such as sec-1-3-1.

youtubeVideoId.description: YouTube video id. Prefer this over url.

url.description: YouTube watch, embed, shorts, or youtu.be URL. Must be YouTube. Ignored as a host if it is not YouTube.

startSec.description: Clip start in seconds from the beginning of the YouTube video (from the VTT cue).

endSec.description: Clip end in seconds. Shown in the UI and passed as the YouTube embed end parameter.

sourceCourse.description: Course section this recording belongs to. Fall 2026 ids: CS4550, CS5610-02, CS5610-09.

semester.description: Season plus 2-digit year. SP26 < SU26 < FA26. Later semesters are not used as fallbacks for an earlier preferred semester.

confidence.description: Tie-break when several clips sit in the same fallback tier. A 0–1 score, or high, medium, low, or placeholder.

note.description: Curator note kept in git. Not rendered on the student page.

parentLectureYoutubeId.description: YouTube id of the full class recording when this row is a short public part. Watch full lecture opens this id with no start time.

fullLectureUrl.description: YouTube URL for the whole lecture. Used as written. Watch, embed, youtu.be, or playlist.

playlistUrl.description: YouTube playlist URL for the lecture. Used as written.

sectionEntry.description: Section-level full-lecture fields apply to clips that omit the same field. A clip-level value wins.
